summary: REQ-1 is only partially addressed: a new DEFAULT_BALANCE constant and a migration that sets balance when it is 0 were added, but the diff does not show profile-creation logic being updated to set the starting balance only for newly created profiles. REQ-3 has new components/props to support a model+color track marker, but the diff summary does not show RacePage actually wiring the active car’s model/color into TrackVisualization. REQ-2 appears to be in progress (Shop groups cars by model and imports the 3D viewer), but the truncated diff does not provide enough evidence that full-design visual previews are rendered and update with color selection. Several unrelated/admin/system features appear to have been added beyond the request.

missing_requirements.requirement: Set the default starting user balance to 1000000000000000 (Nat) for newly created user profiles (and do not modify existing users’ balances).
missing_requirements.reason: The migration sets DEFAULT_BALANCE when an existing stored profile has balance == 0, which can modify existing users (contrary to AC). Also, the diff does not show the user-profile creation/save path setting balance to DEFAULT_BALANCE for brand-new profiles.

missing_requirements.requirement: Shop balance display reflects the new starting balance for new users after profile creation (no manual refresh required beyond existing React Query invalidation/loads).
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the provided diffs/truncation that profile creation triggers the expected query invalidation/update to reflect the new starting balance immediately in the Shop UI.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (mentioned in frontend-file-summaries.txt, but actual diff not shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Shop page supports browsing/selecting full car designs with a clear visual preview that updates when the user changes the selected variant (color).
missing_requirements.reason: ShopPage now groups cars by model and imports CarViewer3D, but the diff is truncated before showing any rendered preview per model and before showing that the preview is actually driven by the selected color variant.

missing_requirements.requirement: On the Race page, the moving player marker in the track visualization reflects the active car’s design (model) and color; fallback to Default Racer blue if none selected.
missing_requirements.reason: TrackVisualization supports playerCarModel/playerCarColor and renders TrackCarMarker accordingly, but the RacePage diff is truncated and does not show TrackVisualization being invoked with the active car’s model/color derived from the active car catalog entry (or fallback logic when no active car is selected).

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new /system route and “System” navigation link/UI.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1/2/3; appears as additional functionality unrelated to starting balance, Shop car design previews, or race track marker visualization.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/authorization UI and command parsing features (AdminGuard, audit log, admin command parser, admin hooks).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; no admin feature work is part of the BuildRequest and it risks scope creep.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced placeholder/stub hooks for MOTD, teams, and leaderboards returning empty data.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1/2/3 and explicitly outside scope of the stated non-goals (adds new feature areas).

hallucinated_features.description: Race history page changed to a 'coming soon' message due to missing backend support.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest is about on-track visualization and shop/balance changes, not removing/altering race history behavior.
